item.title: Heavy Damage, No Injuries Reported in Ogden Street House Fire
item.description: Local firefighters were kept busy Wednesday night after responding to two separate fires just hours apart. The first call came in around 6:25 p.m. for a house fire in the 500 block of Ogden Street in Washington.
